title: Checkout
intro: The server confirms prices and reserves all items together. Payment follows order creation.
pinHelp: Enter both coordinates or select a point on the map. Coordinate fields also work with a keyboard.
mapError: Map unavailable. Enter coordinates in the fields above.
loading: Checking items and placing your order…
offline: You are offline. Reconnect before placing or retrying an order.
invalid: Enter an address, a valid Ethiopian mobile number, and either no coordinates or a valid latitude and longitude pair.
rejected: Checkout could not complete. Review the item checks below and your delivery details. No partial checkout is shown.
uncertain: Confirmation has not arrived. Delivery details are locked; retry sends the same order with the same key. Stay on this page until confirmed.
shortage: Not enough stock. Review this item in your cart.
checkError: This item could not be checked.
priceChanged: The price changed. Review and accept it in your cart.
